activities.description: The narrator introduces the tutorial on making Windows 8 better for gaming.
The narrator explains how to turn off write caching for the main hard drive.
The narrator explains how to adjust Windows for best performance.
The narrator explains how to disable the paging file for users with 8GB or more of RAM.
The narrator explains how to turn off system protection for the main drive (optional).
The narrator explains how to disable user account control notifications.
The narrator explains how to set up Windows backup.
The narrator explains how to download and run CCleaner to clean up the system.
The narrator explains how to change power options to High Performance.
The narrator explains how to download and run Samsung Magician for optimizing Samsung SSDs.
